item.title: Knocked Loose and All-American Rejects Pull Out of Festival
item.description: The All-American Rejects and Knocked Loose have pulled out of Australia’s Good Things festival: American rock band The All-American Rejects and hardcore punk band Knocked Loose were both part of the line-up for Good Things 2025, a music festival being run from December 5 to 7 across Melbourne, Sydney and Brisbane.
